dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: My sister, Safie, seems to have gone missing again...

dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: ...Ah, please don't get me wrong. Safie isn't my real sister, it's because we're a very close-knit group, so we call each other brother and sister.

dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: Our group just received a few new commissions, and one of them really suits her. But she's nowhere to be found... I guess she wandered off somewhere again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't you do it yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: Haha, that won't be necessary. We're not that shorthanded.

dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: I'm the leader of the Eremites in Caravan Ribat. It's best if I stay to supervise public safety here and carry out the maintenance of the Wall of Samiel.

dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: Those are basic orders from the Akademiya, and I can deal with them on my own.

dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: As for the other commissions, my brothers and sisters can see to them. If all of us can make money, we'll live happily together.

dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: Haha, don't worry! Playing cards is like adventuring. Some you win, some you lose!

dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: Wow, you dominated the game! Not surprised I lost to a natural like you.

dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: It's okay. It's not an emergency. No need to bother anyone else.

dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: And she should be able to take care of herself on her own.

dialogues.speaker: Aybak
dialogues.text: But you, you'd better watch yourself. In this place, quite a lot of people come and go... if you know what I mean.
